title: The lock icon on COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold explains why
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • All twelve standard terms are active and COD is the default for new customers.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Hover the lock icon on the "COD" row.
  2. Hover the lock icon on the "Due on Receipt" row.
  3. Hover the lock icon on the "Credit Hold" row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the hover shows "Always available." with the line "COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold can't be deactivated." below it.
  • Step 2: the same two lines show.
  • Step 3: the same two lines show.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-R9: “Hovering the lock icon shows "Always available." with the line "COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold can't be deactivated." below it.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Hover the lock on COD, Due on Receipt or Credit Hold | "Always available." / "COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold can't be deactivated." | Tooltip on hover”
  • Key Decisions: “COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold can never be deactivated.”
